blocks.text: South and North Korea clashed at the United Nations last Thursday over recent land mine explosions in the Demilitarized Zone, with Seoul accusing Pyongyang of violating the Armistice Agreement and demanding an apology while the North denies responsibility. South Korean Ambassador to the UN Cha Ji-hoon raised the Sept. 21 explosions during the general debate of the First Committee of the 81st UN General Assembly in New York, saying three South Korean military personnel were injured. “A joint on-site investigation by ROK military and the UNC supported by forensic analysis confirmed that the explosion was caused by a landmine deliberately planted […]...
